title: How ACP composes with the other seven
caption: Solid lines are documented links: Stripe's SPT implements Delegate Payment and may carry Visa, Mastercard and (on Stripe's seller page by 2026-10-20, absent from its 2026-09-21 capture) American Express agent tokens, and MPP accepts cards through SPTs. Dotted lines mark relations with no bridge or no documented link.
alt: Diagram. ACP's Delegate Payment is implemented by Stripe's SPT. The SPT may carry Visa Intelligent Commerce, Mastercard Agent Pay and, per Stripe's seller page by 2026-10-20 (absent from the 2026-09-21 capture), American Express ACE Kit tokens. Stripe MPP accepts cards through SPTs. Dotted links: ACP and UCP side by side with no bridge; AP2 mandates do not exist in ACP; Visa TAP has no documented link; x402 sits in a different lane next to MPP; ERC-8004 has no documented link.

sourceOfTruth.label: Stripe SPT docs and the ACP repository
